patch.description: Strict JSON object, at most 16384 raw bytes including streamed bodies. Expected revision 0 creates only if absent; positive revision updates only a matching own row and increments atomically. Null clears the required display_name field. Names use Python 3.12 str.strip and at most 80 Unicode code points after stripping; reject NUL/unpaired surrogates. No owner input or Auth metadata write. 409 contains only the own current revision (0 if absent); preserve drafts and refetch. A deleted-owner FK is 403; unrelated errors are not reclassified. Never automatically replay writes after a lost response, 401 or 503. No-store.

patch.description: Strict JSON, at most 16384 raw bytes. Expected revision 0 creates only if absent; positive expectations update only matching own revision. Submit activities and/or plan_draft: omission preserves, activities null resets empty, plan_draft null clears; objects replace their whole section. Each accepted write increments once. Custom text strips once and has 1–200 Unicode code points; incomplete nullable plan drafts are valid. No installed-rule, onboarding, session, reward or profile mutation. 409 SETTINGS_CONFLICT gives only the own current revision; refetch/review and never blindly replay. Deleted-owner FK is 403. Commit precedes success; UTC clocks and no-store.
